name: Michael Peyton
title: Psychologist
description: Croydon Psychology is led by Michael Peyton, who focuses on a collaborative approach to psychological counselling. Member of EMDR Association of Australia (EMDRAA); extensive training in Jungian Psychotherapy at Jung Institute, Zurich. The practice offers Trauma & PTSD counselling in Croydon, Mooroolbark & Ringwood, and telehealth appointments to clients from all over Victoria and Australia.
specialties: Trauma, PTSD, EMDR, Relationship counselling, Addiction, Anxiety, Depression

name: Dr Malcolm Winstanley-Cross
title: Psychologist (Clinical Psychology MA, PhD)
description: Malcolm is an author and commentator with publications focusing on education, training and professional development, resistance to change, gender identity, stress, emotion and ethics, chronic health conditions, ageing and mental health. His publications include work on issues in therapy with lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender clients, affirmative therapy, sexual orientation and mental health, and treating Post Traumatic Stress Disorder.
specialties: Stress and burnout, Counselling, Coaching, Gender identity, LGBT affirmative therapy, PTSD

name: Rachel Benedikt
title: Clinical and Counselling Psychologist / Psychotherapist
description: As a psychologist I offer you support and understanding whilst assisting you to work through your difficulties. I offer individual and couple consultations to address a wide range of issues, including relationships, sexual issues, and sexuality issues (eg. coming out). Fellow of the APS Colleges of Clinical & Counselling Psychologists.
specialties: Sexual Issues, Sexuality Issues (coming out), Couples, Anxiety, Depression, Eating disorders, Infertility

name: Dr Christina Faber
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Christina's therapeutic approach draws upon a range of evidence-based modalities, with her work mainly informed by EMDR therapy, parts work, mindfulness, and self-compassion. She applies these modalities within a trauma-informed framework, supporting clients to develop emotional regulation, present-moment awareness, and internal stability. She developed and facilitated a trauma treatment program for emergency service workers.
specialties: EMDR, Parts work, Trauma, Mindfulness, Self-compassion, Emergency service workers
